6.321 rsPagePropertyInSubsequentReportSection
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsPagePropertyInSubsequentReportSection is a non-critical error that will occur when a Page element
in any ReportSection except the first ReportSection contains any child elements.
